title: The log is refused by the server without Settings Finance
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user whose role has no Settings → Finance.
custom_steps: 1. Request the Credit Terms Log by a means other than the page, as a user without Settings → Finance.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The request is refused.

Such a user cannot reach the page or its menu. This part is for an automated check.
